parameters.query: INSERT INTO vilqa.profile_notifications(user_id,profile_version,actor_id,message_text) VALUES($1::bigint,$2::integer,$3::bigint,$4::text) ON CONFLICT(user_id,profile_version) DO NOTHING RETURNING user_id,profile_version,message_text;

UPDATE vilqa.profile_notifications SET status=CASE WHEN $3::boolean THEN 'sent' ELSE 'failed' END,telegram_message_id=$4::bigint,completed_at=now() WHERE user_id=$1::bigint AND profile_version=$2::integer RETURNING status;

parameters.query: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM vilqa.nav_operations WHERE user_id=$1::bigint AND event_key='miniapp:'||$2||':recipe-state' AND status IN ('succeeded','pending','in_flight','superseded')) THEN jsonb_build_object('success',true) ELSE jsonb_build_object('success',false,'status',503,'message','Не удалось открыть создание рецепта. Попробуй ещё раз или открой бота') END AS response;

INSERT INTO vilqa.meal_notifications(entry_id,user_id,message_text) SELECT $1::bigint,$2::bigint,$3::text WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM vilqa.diary WHERE id=$1::bigint AND user_id=$2::bigint AND deleted_at IS NULL AND item_type='recipe') ON CONFLICT(entry_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING entry_id,user_id,message_text;
UPDATE vilqa.meal_notifications SET status=$3::text,telegram_message_id=$4::bigint,completed_at=now() WHERE entry_id=$1::bigint AND user_id=$2::bigint RETURNING entry_id,status;

SELECT d.user_id,d.date,COALESCE(p.data->>'timezone','Europe/Moscow') AS timezone FROM vilqa.diary d JOIN vilqa.meal_notifications n ON n.entry_id=d.id LEFT JOIN vilqa.profiles p ON p.user_id=d.user_id WHERE d.id=$1::bigint AND n.user_id=d.user_id AND n.status='sent' AND vilqa.access_check(d.user_id);
